item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00160","decision":"none","candidate_ranking":["C24","C02","C03"],"selected_candidate_label":null,"confidence":0.93,"relationship_type":"none","rationale":"The closest candidates concern intellectual-property rights and reciprocal foreign treatment, but none supplies the child's concrete copyright machinery.
